Source-only: the notes button inverts notesExpanded, commits it, and has one request-bound event call choosing closed when false; the body is conditional on notesExpanded. The selected native route did not execute closing. Source declaration/branch review only; no unexecuted runtime proof.

Source-only: the self row calls the common chooser; a different unsent choice assigns self, clears acknowledgment and calls the request-bound collector event once. Self makes valid true and excludes the acknowledgment branch. No self-after-delegate native activation was exercised. Source declaration/branch review only; no unexecuted runtime proof.

Source-only: the guarded acknowledgment setter accepts a changed false value before submission, commits false and calls one current-request ack event. Delegate validity then requires the now-false acknowledgment. The runtime route only toggled true. Source declaration/branch review only; no unexecuted runtime proof.

Source-only: self is valid, confirmation is enabled while unsent, and the guarded handler records submitted before one submit event using self raw/event value. Submitted controls, label and status read submitted. Native confirmation covered delegate only. Source declaration/branch review only; no unexecuted runtime proof.

Source-only: equality with the current collector returns before state mutation and the sole collector event call. No same-choice dispatch or empty runtime event interval is inferred. Source declaration/branch review only; no unexecuted runtime proof.

Source-only: native enabled/disabled bindings are paired with business guards. Choice returns for submitted or unavailable delegate; acknowledgment requires unsent available delegate and a changed value; confirmation requires unsent and valid. No disabled-control runtime activation was attempted. Source declaration/branch review only; no unexecuted runtime proof.
